messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy v3.0.1 completed to production at 2026-03-15T15:42:00Z :rocket:

maya (oncall): getting flooded with alerts. p99 latency for /v1/stream climbing from 1.1s -> 9s, error spikes to ~7% and we are seeing connection resets.

rick (eng-sre): pulling dashboard now. can you paste an example trace?

lisa (prod): pasted tail of access logs: a bunch of clients with long-lived streaming requests showing upstream reset and then immediate retry, roughly same client ids repeating. status 499/aborted and some 502 from gateway.

maya (oncall): ops-pager-bot paging rick and tana :bell:

ops-pager-bot: Paging rick (eng-sre), tana (eng-runtime) — elevated error rate detected on prod. Priority P1.

tana (eng-runtime): I can confirm v3.0.1 included a lightweight sidecar change: switched keepalive/idle-timeout default from 120s -> 15s to free up sockets faster. That interacts poorly with our streaming endpoints. hypothesis: short upstream idle timeout closes streaming upstreams mid-request causing client retries and thundering retries overload.

rick (eng-sre): good hypothesis. also seeing a large bump in request churn metrics and worker threads hitting accept queue saturation. queue_wait histogram showing big tail.

lisa (prod): impact: ~8% of streaming traffic in us-east-1 and us-west-2 impacted. Several enterprise customers reported aborted streams and duplicate partial responses.

maya (oncall): quick mitigation options: 1) revert sidecar change (full rollback), 2) hotpatch gateway upstream timeout back to 120s via dynamic config for streaming routes, 3) traffic-shed clients with >n retries. Fastest is #2 if we can change config fast.

ops-pager-bot: Incident created: Incident 2187659999 - streaming resets after deploy. Link: https://bit.ly/ri-incident-2187659999

rick (eng-sre): I'm for hotpatch first to stop the cascade. If we can't push that immediately, we'll rollback. Tana, can you push dynamic config to us-east-1 gateway pool?

tana (eng-runtime): I can do that. patching upstream idle_timeout=120s for route /v1/stream in us-east-1 now. will monitor.

lisa (prod): applying config -> running command: `gwctl set-route-config --cluster=us-east --route=/v1/stream --upstream-idle-timeout=120s`

maya (oncall): support and CS informed. creating quick blast: "We are investigating streaming resets impacting some customers, workarounds include switching to non-streamed endpoints if feasible."

rick (eng-sre): after config change p99 dropped from 9s -> 1.4s in 45s, error rate from 7% -> 0.8%. queue waits reducing. Looks like mitigated for now.

tana (eng-runtime): canary nodes in us-east-1 show stable connections. Will keep the dynamic config for 30m while we decide rollback vs config-only fix.

lisa (prod): customer-impact note: flagged 4 enterprise customers for immediate call; CS handling.

maya (oncall): decision needed: full rollback of v3.0.1 or remove the sidecar default in release and keep dynamic config as stopgap. Risk of rollback: longer deploy windows but safer for traffic.

rick (eng-sre): recommend revert the sidecar change from the release artifact and redeploy a patch v3.0.2 without the idle-timeout tweak. We'll keep dynamic config in place during rollout.

tana (eng-runtime): agree. I'll prepare a small patch and run a targeted canary with heavy synthetic streaming load. no re-rollout until traces look good.

ops-pager-bot: Change applied: upstream idle_timeout set to 120s in us-east-1 by tana (eng-runtime).

maya (oncall): monitoring global metrics. creating incident note: MITIGATION - dynamic gateway timeout change applied to streaming route; rolling patch planned.

rick (eng-sre): scheduling postmortem. owner: rick. will include root cause analysis, retro on release gating, and pre-deploy streaming stress tests.

lisa (prod): rollback not required at this time. re-deploy plan: v3.0.2 remove sidecar idle_timeout change, run targeted canary with synthetic streams for 20m, then progressive rollout.

customer-success: drafting customer message: "We experienced intermittent streaming interruptions for some customers after a recent deploy. We applied a fix and are rolling a safe patch; reach out to support for impacted sessions."

maya (oncall): handing off to rick for postmortem. stepping out of pager. :wave:

rick (eng-sre): taking ownership. setting 45m follow-up bridge to verify patch rollout. will attach relevant logs and trace IDs to the incident doc. closing on-call handoff.

ops-pager-bot: Incident state changed to MONITORING by rick (eng-sre)."
